content: I noticed new registrations are happening, and I wanted to check if the recent blockers that were stopping people register had been resolved?

Just tried again with my https://github.com/gdahia/ShelahHalesJewett/ repository on Lean4.35.0, and it failed with the same reason: https://github.com/PalomarRegistry/PalomarSubmission/actions/runs/39406756056/job/118574488807

I guess the reason those new registrations went through is that they are using older versions of Lean, but I have not checked it
is there any admin here that can look at this or point us in the right direction? Happy to use whichever version of lean will be registered
I am not an admin, but it seems to me (from other threads and checking the details in recent successful submissions) that using leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0-rc3 works

Yeah, rebuilding with the correct lake, Mathlib, Verso and proof widget is important for seamless submission. I suggest to fix leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0-rc3 along with correct Pins. Sharing the manifest here which worked for me an hour ago: https://github.com/shaikidris/priority-controller-phase1/blob/9df72ff8f5e9f9b224680d4bcf151bc7d2491da9/lake-manifest.json
